action: Cobre clients: follow the company's direct communications and use only its official channels for updates; no vendor fix or indicators have been published.
date_note: Cobre says the incident occurred in the early hours of Thursday 19 November 2026 (Portafolio, published 19 Nov).
exec: A Latin American B2B payments provider reports an incident under containment; clients should watch its notices.
geo_basis: country as stated (Colombian fintech); no city given in the source
plain: Cobre, a Colombian company that handles payments between businesses, says it had a cybersecurity incident on 19 November and is containing it. It says client funds and client data were not affected.
summary: Cobre, a Colombian business-payments fintech, confirmed a cybersecurity incident that it says occurred early on 19 November 2026 and said it is working on containment. The company says client funds remain intact and that client data and credentials were not affected or accessed, per its own account while the investigation continues. It did not specify the origin, systems involved or scope.
title: Cobre, Colombian payments fintech, confirms cybersecurity incident and says it is containing it
